note: The death summary (core/game/game_death.gd, drawn by ui/play/death_panel.gd): shown when an heir dies, before the succession screen. It only reads what the dynasty already keeps (last_death, the house, heirlooms, echoes, the candidates); it changes no rule of death or succession. Text is here, in the same {name} style as the other catalogs.

text.killer_old: What killed me: old age, the years themselves.
text.killer_slain_unknown: What killed me: something in the fight; no one saw what.
text.carries_gear: Their gear and {n} things in the pack.
text.carries_echoes: The family's echoes, fading by {pct}% as a generation passes.
text.fate: Fate has left its mark: the next heir will be a {name}.
text.carry_hint: {n} may carry the family name. You choose next.
